Task: Atomise the HEAD note `20_Thinking/21_Workbench/HEAD - The Trap of the Architect` and pull it into `30_Library/`.
Constraints & Setup:

* Use `10_System/prompts/00 - Prompt Library Router` to select the appropriate prompt (answer: two-step atomic-capture pipeline: [[Atomic Signal Extractor → Write TMP file]] → [[Atomic Linker → Promote & Connect]])
* Semantically search the vault for related notes to link and create typed edges
* You may override the agent restrictions on creating new notes for this task
* Use only the 1MCP obsidian tools for clean file updates
* Follow AGENTS.md §9.3 typed-edge exception (only add/edit typed edges and `axiom:` markers in `30_Library/` notes, don't author new claim prose)
* Run `edge_lint.py --audit` before starting (§9.2), and `edge_lint.py --path "<file>"` on all modified notes to validate (§9.4) — must report 0 errors before done

Vault context: `/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon` — the HEAD note is already rich with analysis mapping back to ~20 existing vault claims (see lines 59–107 of the note itself).

cmd: cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && find . -iname "*Typed Edge Vocabulary*" -o -iname "*Knowledge Compiler*" -o -iname "*Frontmatter Contract*" -o -iname "*HEAD Note Contract*" 2>/dev/null
cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --audit 2>&1 | tail -80
cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && ls 30_Library/100_zettelkasten/ | head -40 && echo "---count---" && ls 30_Library/100_zettelkasten/ | wc -l
cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --audit 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|ERROR\(S\)|0 error" | head -20

cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && find 30_Library/100_zettelkasten -iname "*Prosthetic Executive Function*" -o -iname "*Think Like a Man of Action*" -o -iname "*ADHD Overthinking*" -o -iname "*Motivation, Volition*" -o -iname "*System-Hopping*" -o -iname "*Pseudo-productivity*"

cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && find . -iname "*Prosthetic Executive Function*" -o -iname "*Cognitive Physiology of Task Execution*" -o -iname "*Man of Action*" -o -iname "*ADHD Neurology*" -o -iname "*Processing IS the Work*" -o -iname "*Perfectionism and Analysis Paralysis*" -o -iname "*Execution Protocol for High-Friction*" -o -iname "*Purpose of my PKM system*" -o -iname "*Inaction Erodes Self-Trust*" -o -iname "*Misinterpretation as Character Flaws*" -o -iname "*ADHD Task Initiation is Not Universally*" -o -iname "*Fall to the Level of Your Systems*" 2>/dev/null

cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && find . -iname "*3 Rules*Starter*" -o -iname "*Three Rules of Starter Tasks*" 2>/dev/null; find /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/Hermes -iname "*Execution Protocol for High-Friction*" 2>/dev/null
cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && grep -l "^type: concept" 30_Library/100_zettelkasten/*.md | xargs -I{} grep -l "kind: atomic" {} 2>/dev/null | head -3

cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && for f in \
  "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/The Trap of the Architect Is Sophisticated System-Building Substituting for Physical Action.md" \
  "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Claim - Action Precedes Motivation Is a Directional Heuristic, Not an Absolute Law.md" \
  "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Claim - Stripping Away Systems Under-Weights the Need for Pre-Committed External Prosthetics.md" \
  "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Claim - Analysing One's Own Avoidance Can Itself Be an Instance of the Avoidance It Describes.md" \
; do
  echo "=== $f ==="
  uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --path "$f" 2>&1
  echo
done
cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --path "30_Library/100_zettelkasten" 2>&1 | tail -20
cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --path . --quiet 2>&1 | tail -10

cd "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon" && uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --path . 2>&1 | grep -B3 -i "Trap of the Architect\|Action Precedes Motivation\|Stripping Away Systems\|Analysing One's Own Avoidance"
